result.instructions: Tools for MarketTime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders came in this week and what is still unshipped?"; "Show the lines of the latest order from Main Street Boutique."; "Which items are out of stock or low on inventory?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MarketTime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run markettime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run markettime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run markettime_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. markettime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: markettime_list_manufacturers
tools.title: List manufacturers
tools.description: List the manufacturers (brands) connected to this account: id, name, email, city, category, connection date. Sort fields: name (default), manufacturerID, connectionDate, dateAdded, dateModified, city. GET /manufacturers.

active.description: true = only active manufacturers, false = only inactive.

sort.description: Sort field, e.g. name, connectionDate, dateModified.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_get_manufacturer
tools.title: Get manufacturer
tools.description: One manufacturer's details by its id (like M123). GET /manufacturers/{id}.

tools.name: markettime_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: Search wholesale orders (for the newest first use sort_field orderDate with sort_direction desc). Convenience filters: status (the manufacturer's order status, e.g. NEW, SENT, SHIPPED), rep_group_status (Rep Group accounts only), po_number, customer_name (contains), manufacturer_id, customer_id, ordered_from/ordered_to (order date), modified_since. Order lines are left out unless include_details is true (they make replies large; use markettime_list_order_details for the lines of one order). Card tokens are never returned. POST /orders/get.

rep_group_status.description: repGroupOrderStatus equals this value (Rep Group accounts).

po_number.description: Purchase order number equals this value.

modified_since.description: Only orders changed on or after this date.

filters.description: Extra filters, all combined with AND. Use field names from the record shape of this tool's replies.

field.description: Field name on the record, e.g. orderDate, name, dateModified.

operator.description: Comparison; starts_with, ends_with and contains work on text fields only.

value.description: The value to compare with (dates as yyyy-mm-dd).

sort_field.description: Sort field, e.g. orderDate, dateModified, orderTotal, poNumber.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_order_details
tools.title: List order lines
tools.description: List order lines (item, quantity, unit price) across orders or for one order (order_id). Filters: order dates, statuses, manufacturer, PO number, unit price range. GET /orders/orderdetails.

order_id.description: Only the lines of this order (the order's recordID).

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_get_order_changes_history
tools.title: Get order changes history
tools.description: The audit trail of one order: who changed what and when (Rep Group accounts). POST /orders/{orderId}/orderChangesHistory/get (a read-only search).

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: Shipment and tracking records of one order (tracking number, link, carrier, ship date, invoice). GET /orders/{orderId}/trackingdetails/get.

tools.name: markettime_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (retailers/buyers) with name, email, address, status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LEAD), customer number and salesperson. Filters: name (contains), state, status, modified_since. The customers' own API keys are never returned. POST /customers/get.

modified_since.description: Only customers changed on or after this date.

rep_group_id.description: Manufacturer accounts only: limit to this Rep Group's customers.

filters.description: Extra filters, all combined with AND. Use field names from the record shape of this tool's replies.

field.description: Field name on the record, e.g. orderDate, name, dateModified.

operator.description: Comparison; starts_with, ends_with and contains work on text fields only.

value.description: The value to compare with (dates as yyyy-mm-dd).

sort_field.description: customerNumber: Rep Group accounts only; accountNumber and shipToAccountNumber: Manufacturer accounts only.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer's full record by id (like B123): addresses, contacts, ship-to locations, terms, pricing method. Their API key is never returned. GET /customers/{id}.

rep_group_id.description: Manufacturer accounts only: the Rep Group the customer belongs to.

tools.name: markettime_list_customer_contacts
tools.title: List customer contacts
tools.description: The contact people of one customer (name, email, phone, title). GET /customers/{id}/contacts.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_customer_ship_to_locations
tools.title: List customer ship-to locations
tools.description: The ship-to locations of one customer (name, address, account number). GET /customers/{id}/shiptolocations.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: Search the product catalog: item number, name, prices, case quantity, stock, UPC, categories, images. Filters: name (contains), item_number, manufacturer_id, modified_since. POST /items/get.

modified_since.description: Only items changed on or after this date.

filters.description: Extra filters, all combined with AND. Use field names from the record shape of this tool's replies.

field.description: Field name on the record, e.g. orderDate, name, dateModified.

operator.description: Comparison; starts_with, ends_with and contains work on text fields only.

value.description: The value to compare with (dates as yyyy-mm-dd).

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One catalog item by its numeric record id (the recordID/itemID in item lists). GET /items/{itemID}.

tools.name: markettime_list_item_inventory
tools.title: List item inventory
tools.description: Stock levels per item: quantity available, quantity on the water, next available date, availability flag. Sort fields: itemNumber, nextAvailableDate, qtyAvailable, isAvailable. GET /items/inventory.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_item_pricing
tools.title: List item pricing
tools.description: Pricing detail per item (unit price, retail price, price codes, discounts). GET /items/pricing.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_salespersons
tools.title: List salespersons
tools.description: List the Rep Group's salespeople (name, abbreviation, status, ids). Rep Group accounts only. POST /salespersons/get.

offset.description: Start index (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: markettime_list_commission_order_payments
tools.title: List commission order payments
tools.description: Order payment and commission records (what was paid on which order, commission percent), Rep Group accounts only. Filters: order_id, modified_since, or custom filters (allowed fields: orderID, checkLogID, invoiceNumber, type, commissionPayDate, salespersonPaidID, dateAdded, dateModified). Card tokens and card data are never returned. Paged by page number. POST /commissions/orderpayments/get.

order_id.description: Only payments of this order (field orderID).

filters.description: Extra filters, all combined with AND. Use field names from the record shape of this tool's replies.

field.description: Field name on the record, e.g. orderDate, name, dateModified.

operator.description: Comparison; starts_with, ends_with and contains work on text fields only.

value.description: The value to compare with (dates as yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: markettime_create_order_shipment
tools.title: Create order shipment
tools.description: WRITE: add a shipment with tracking to an order (manufacturer accounts only). This creates a new shipment record each time it is called (it is not idempotent) and MarketTime may notify the customer of the tracking details; calling it twice makes a duplicate. Check markettime_list_order_shipments first. POST /orders/{orderId}/trackingdetails.

shipping_method.description: Carrier / shipping method, e.g. UPS Ground.

tools.name: markettime_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (retailer) account record. It is not idempotent: calling it twice may create two customers, so search with markettime_list_customers by name first. Does not send an invitation by itself. POST /customers.

phone.description: Phone number, at most 12 characters (MarketTime limit).

country.description: Country code, at most 4 characters (e.g. US).

external_id.description: Your own id for this customer, to link external systems.
